summary: AdvanSix Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new credit agreement, refinancing its existing senior secured revolving facility. The new agreement provides a $275 million revolving credit facility and a $150 million term loan facility, both maturing August 14, 2031. Borrowings bear interest at base rate or Term SOFR plus applicable margins, with commitment fees on unused commitments. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation; it does not involve a change of control, restructuring, or other event covered by the special-situations categories. The filing includes exhibits but no deal terms related to securities transactions.
